description:
Add the public TypeScript types and tool-schema literals for orchestration. This is the schema lock every other minions issue imports.

## Background

Without a closed `taskType` union and explicit packet/group types, later issues will invent incompatible shapes (or resurrect `validation`, `protocolStatus`, `operationId`). This issue exists so parallel work shares one contract.

## Files

- `packages/pi-minions/src/types.ts` (extend, do not fork AgentTree types into a second registry)
- new `packages/pi-minions/src/task-types.ts` for the enum + nudge policy *table placeholder* if you keep strings here; actual policy copy can land in the nudges issue if you only export the union here. Prefer: union + NudgeEvent live here; policy strings in the nudges issue that imports the union.

## Technical approach

```ts
type TaskType = "implementation" | "fix" | "reviewImplementation" | "reviewScope" | "investigateBlocker";
type NudgeEvent = "settled" | "aborted" | "failed" | "parentMessage";
```

No `validation`. No `completed`. OrchestrateInput: optional groupId, optional cwd (group create only), tasks[] with required description, optional role/taskType/model/domain. Domain: `{ source, scopeId?, workItemId?, title? }` opaque. OrchestrateResult: groupId, accepted[{childId, description, state:"starting"}], rejected[{index, reason}].

Do not add assignmentPermit, operationId, protocolStatus, SubmittedTaskResult.

Use a real string enum in the TypeBox tool schema (provider-visible closed list).

## Success criteria

- Types compile; TaskType rejects unknown strings at the schema layer.
- No beadwork imports in pi-minions.
- Existing spawn types still work (`agent` remains on spawn).

## Test plan

- Unit: schema accepts the five task types; rejects `validation` and junk.
- Unit: description required on orchestrate task descriptors (can be schema-only tests even before the tool exists).
- Unit: role remains an open string.

## Considerations

This issue owns `types.ts` / `task-types.ts` only. Do not rewrite `tools/spawn.ts` or `tree.ts` here (those are sibling issues). If you must touch AgentNode, add optional fields with defaults so current spawn still compiles.
title: Add orchestration public types and closed taskType schema
